{{Top|leg}}
'''Molpol's Traveling Circus''' was a [[Circus/Legends|circus]] that traveled across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], much like [[Circus Horrificus/Legends|Circus Horrificus]].

The circus toured with exotic creatures, including an [[Albino/Legends|albino]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], and otherwise featured live music, acrobats, illusionists, and other sideshow oddities.
